אלה ברכב. יש מן האומות שבוטחים ברכב ברזל שלהם ויש שבוטחים בסוסיהם אבל אנחנו בשם ה' נזכיר כי לו הישועה נזכיר לשון הקטרה ותפלה כמו (ישעיהו ס״ו:ג׳) מזכיר לבונה את אזכרתה (ויקרא א') ולפי' המה יכרעו ויפולו:

sections.en:
They [call] on chariots, they [call] on horses,
but we call on the name of the LORD our God.
sections.he: אֵלֶּה בָרֶכֶב וְאֵלֶּה בַסּוּסִים וַאֲנַחְנוּ בְּשֵׁם־יְהֹוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃

comments.en: but we rise and gain strength We gain strength over them, as (below 147:6): “strengthens (מעודד) the humble,” an expression of strength.

comments.he: ואנחנו קמנו ונתעודד. נתגבר עליהם כמו (לקמן קמז) מעודד ענוים לשון עוז:

sections.en:
They collapse and lie fallen,
but we rally and gather strength.
sections.he: הֵמָּה כָּרְעוּ וְנָפָלוּ וַאֲנַחְנוּ קַּמְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃

sections.en:
O LORD, grant victory!
May the King answer us when we call.
sections.he: יְהֹוָה הוֹשִׁיעָה הַמֶּלֶךְ יַעֲנֵנוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ׃

comments.en: This portion, known as Kedushas d’Sidra, was introduced at the conclusion of the morning service to accomodate those who came to the synagogue too late to hear the Kedushah in Shemoneh Esrei. The Talmud (Maseches Sotah 49a) declares that the world is preserved solely by virtue of this Kedushah, and by the virtue of our answering, “May His great Name,” which is part of the Kaddish recited following the study of the Aggadah. Because of its importance, a vernacular translation in Aramaic was added, so that even those ignorant of Hebrew would understand the sacred words.
comments.he: מה שתקנו סדר קדושה בסוף התפלה בעבור עמי הארץ המאחרים לבא לתפלה שלא יפסידו שמיעת הקדושה. דאמרינן בשלהי סוטה אמאי קאי עלמא אסדרא דקדושה ואיהא שמיה רבה דאגדתא. ולכך תקנו לתרגם סדר קדושה זה כדי שיבינו עמי הארץ שאין מכירים לדבר בלשון הקדש אלא בלשון תרגום שהיו רגילין לדבר בו באותו זמן. en:
He shall come as redeemer to Zion,
To those in Jacob who turn back from sin
—declares the LORD.

And this shall be My covenant with them, said the L<small>ORD</small>: My spirit which is upon you, and the words which I have placed in your mouth, shall not be absent from your mouth, nor from the mouth of your children, nor from the mouth of your children’s children—said the L<small>ORD</small>—from now on, for all time.
he: וּבָ֤א לְצִיּוֹן֙ גּוֹאֵ֔ל וּלְשָׁבֵ֥י פֶ֖שַׁע בְּיַֽעֲקֹ֑ב נְאֻ֖ם יְהֹוָֽה׃

וַאֲנִ֗י זֹ֣את בְּרִיתִ֤י אוֹתָם֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה רוּחִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלֶ֔יךָ וּדְבָרַ֖י אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֣מְתִּי בְּפִ֑יךָ לֹֽא־יָמ֡וּשׁוּ מִפִּ֩יךָ֩ וּמִפִּ֨י זַרְעֲךָ֜ וּמִפִּ֨י זֶ֤רַע זַרְעֲךָ֙ אָמַ֣ר יְהֹוָ֔ה מֵעַתָּ֖ה וְעַד־עוֹלָֽם׃ {ס}

comments.en: Then a spirit carried me away, and behind me I heard a great roaring sound: “Blessed is the Presence of the L<small>ORD</small>, in His place,”
comments.he: וַתִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי ר֔וּחַ וָאֶשְׁמַ֣ע אַחֲרַ֔י ק֖וֹל רַ֣עַשׁ גָּד֑וֹל בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבוֹד־יְהֹוָ֖ה מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃

comments.en: a good number of their children spoke the language of Ashdod and the language of those various peoples, and did not know how to speak Judean.
comments.he: וּבְנֵיהֶ֗ם חֲצִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אַשְׁדּוֹדִ֔ית וְאֵינָ֥ם מַכִּירִ֖ים לְדַבֵּ֣ר יְהוּדִ֑ית וְכִלְשׁ֖וֹן עַ֥ם וָעָֽם׃

sections.en: The Redeemer shall come to Zion and to those of Jacob who repent from sin, says Adonoy. As for Me, this is My covenant with them, said Adonoy: My spirit which is upon you, and My words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart from your mouth, nor from the mouth of your children, nor from the mouth of your children’s children, said Adonoy— from now to eternity.
sections.he: וּבָא לְצִיּוֹן גּוֹאֵל וּלְשָׁבֵי פֶֽשַׁע בְּיַעֲקֹב נְאֻם יְהֹוָה: וַאֲנִי זֹאת בְּרִיתִי אֹתָם אָמַר יְהֹוָה רוּחִי אֲשֶׁר עָלֶֽיךָ וּדְבָרַי אֲשֶׁר שַֽׂמְתִּי בְּפִֽיךָ לֺא יָמֽוּשׁוּ מִפִּֽיךָ וּמִפִּי זַרְעֲךָ וּמִפִּי זֶֽרַע זַרְעֲךָ אָמַר יְהֹוָה מֵעַתָּה וְעַד עוֹלָם:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Concluding Prayers, Uva Letzion 2

comments.en:
And one would call to the other,
“Holy, holy, holy!
The LORD of Hosts!
His presence fills all the earth!”
comments.he: וְקָרָ֨א זֶ֤ה אֶל־זֶה֙ וְאָמַ֔ר קָד֧וֹשׁ ׀ קָד֛וֹשׁ קָד֖וֹשׁ יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת מְלֹ֥א כׇל־הָאָ֖רֶץ כְּבוֹדֽוֹ׃

comments.en:
But You are the Holy One,
enthroned,
the Praise of Israel.
comments.he: וְאַתָּ֥ה קָד֑וֹשׁ י֝וֹשֵׁ֗ב תְּהִלּ֥וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

sections.en: And You, Holy One, are enthroned upon the praises of Israel. And [the angels] call one to another and say: Holy, holy, holy is Adonoy of Hosts: the fullness of all the earth is His glory.”
sections.he:
וְאַתָּה קָדוֹשׁ יוֹשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל: וְקָרָא זֶה אֶל זֶה וְאָמַר:
קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ קָדוֹשׁ יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת מְלֺא כָל הָאָֽרֶץ כְּבוֹדוֹ:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Concluding Prayers, Uva Letzion 3

sections.en: And they receive [sanction] one from another, and say, Holy in the highest heights of heaven, the abode of His Divine Presence; holy upon earth, the work of His mighty power; holy forever and to all eternity— is Adonoy of hosts; the whole earth is filled with the radiance of His glory.
sections.he: <small no-hachana>וּמְקַבְּלִין דֵּין מִן דֵּין וְאָמְרִין קַדִּישׁ בִּשְׁמֵי מְרוֹמָא עִלָּאָה בֵּית שְׁכִינְתֵּהּ קַדִּישׁ עַל אַרְעָא עוֹבַד גְּבוּרְתֵּהּ קַדִּישׁ לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת, מַלְיָא כָל אַרְעָא זִיו יְקָרֵהּ:</small>
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Concluding Prayers, Uva Letzion 4

comments.en: Then a spirit carried me away, and behind me I heard a great roaring sound: “Blessed is the Presence of the L<small>ORD</small>, in His place,”
comments.he: וַתִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי ר֔וּחַ וָאֶשְׁמַ֣ע אַחֲרַ֔י ק֖וֹל רַ֣עַשׁ גָּד֑וֹל בָּר֥וּךְ כְּבוֹד־יְהֹוָ֖ה מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃

sections.en: And a wind lifted me; and I heard behind me the sound of a great rushing; Blessed is the glory of Adonoy from His place.
sections.he:
וַתִּשָּׂאֵֽנִי רֽוּחַ וָאֶשְׁמַע אַחֲרַי קוֹל רַֽעַשׁ גָּדוֹל:
בָּרוּךְ כְּבוֹד יְהֹוָה מִמְּקוֹמוֹ:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Concluding Prayers, Uva Letzion 5

sections.en: And a wind lifted me and I heard behind me a sound of a great rushing of those who uttered praises and said, ‘Blessed is the glory of Adonoy from the place, the abode of His Divine Presence.
sections.he: <small no-hachana>וּנְטָלַתְנִי רוּחָא וּשְׁמָעִית בַּתְרַי קָל זִֽיעַ סַגִּיא דִּמְשַׁבְּחִין וְאָמְרִין בְּרִיךְ יְקָרָא דַיהוָֹה מֵאֲתַר בֵּית שְׁכִינְתֵּהּ:</small>
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Concluding Prayers, Uva Letzion 6

comments.en: The L<small>ORD</small> will reign for ever and ever!
comments.he: יְהֹוָ֥ה ׀ יִמְלֹ֖ךְ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

sections.en: Adonoy will reign forever and ever.
sections.he: יְהֹוָה יִמְלֺךְ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Concluding Prayers, Uva Letzion 7

sections.en: Adonoy, His kingdom is established forever and to all eternity.
sections.he: <small no-hachana>יְהֹוָה מַלְכוּתֵהּ קָאֵים לְעָלַם וּלְעָלְמֵי עָלְמַיָּא:</small>
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Concluding Prayers, Uva Letzion 8

comments.en: O L<small>ORD</small> God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our fathers, remember this to the eternal credit of the thoughts of Your people’s hearts, and make their hearts constant toward You.
comments.he: יְהֹוָ֗ה אֱ֠לֹהֵ֠י אַבְרָהָ֞ם יִצְחָ֤ק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲבֹתֵ֔ינוּ שׇׁמְרָה־זֹּ֣את לְעוֹלָ֔ם לְיֵ֥צֶר מַחְשְׁב֖וֹת לְבַ֣ב עַמֶּ֑ךָ וְהָכֵ֥ן לְבָבָ֖ם אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

comments.en:
But He, being merciful, forgave iniquity
and would not destroy;
He restrained His wrath time and again
and did not give full vent to His fury;
comments.he: וְה֤וּא רַח֨וּם ׀ יְכַפֵּ֥ר עָוֺן֮ וְֽלֹא־יַֽ֫שְׁחִ֥ית וְ֭הִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁ֣יב אַפּ֑וֹ וְלֹא־יָ֝עִ֗יר כׇּל־חֲמָתֽוֹ׃

comments.en:
For You, Lord, are good and forgiving,
abounding in steadfast love to all who call on You.
comments.he: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי ט֣וֹב וְסַלָּ֑ח וְרַב־חֶ֝֗סֶד לְכׇל־קֹֽרְאֶֽיךָ׃

comments.en:
Your righteousness is eternal;
Your teaching is true.
comments.he: צִדְקָתְךָ֣ צֶ֣דֶק לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְֽתוֹרָתְךָ֥ אֱמֶֽת׃

comments.en:
Blessed is the Lord.
Day by day He supports us,
God, our deliverance. Selah.
comments.he: בָּ֤ר֣וּךְ אֲדֹנָי֮ י֤וֹם ׀ י֥֫וֹם יַעֲמׇס־לָ֗נוּ הָ֘אֵ֤ל יְֽשׁוּעָתֵ֬נוּ סֶֽלָה׃

comments.en:
The LORD of hosts is with us;
the God of Jacob is our haven. Selah.
comments.he: יְהֹוָ֣ה צְבָא֣וֹת עִמָּ֑נוּ מִשְׂגָּֽב־לָ֨נוּ אֱלֹהֵ֖י יַֽעֲקֹ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃

comments.en:
O LORD of hosts,
happy is the man who trusts in You.
comments.he: יְהֹוָ֥ה צְבָא֑וֹת אַֽשְׁרֵ֥י אָ֝דָ֗ם בֹּטֵ֥חַ בָּֽךְ׃ {פ}

comments.en:
O LORD, grant victory!
May the King answer us when we call.
comments.he: יְהֹוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־קׇרְאֵֽנוּ׃ {פ}

comments.en:
You will keep faith with Jacob,
Loyalty to Abraham,
As You promised on oath to our fathers
In days gone by.
comments.he: תִּתֵּ֤ן אֱמֶת֙ לְיַֽעֲקֹ֔ב חֶ֖סֶד לְאַבְרָהָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר־נִשְׁבַּ֥עְתָּ לַאֲבֹתֵ֖ינוּ מִ֥ימֵי קֶֽדֶם׃

sections.en: Adonoy, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, our fathers, keep this forever as the intention of the hearts of Your people, and direct their hearts to You. And He, the merciful One, atones iniquity and does not destroy; He frequently withdraws His anger and does not arouse all His rage. For You, my Master, are good and forgiving, and abounding in kindness to all who call upon You. Your righteousness is everlasting and Your Torah is truth. You will grant truth to Jacob, kindliness to Abraham, as You have sworn to our fathers from the days of old. Blessed is my Master day by day; He loads us [with blessings], the Almighty Who is our deliverance, forever. Adonoy of Hosts is with us a stronghold for us is the God of Jacob, Selah. Adonoy of Hosts, fortunate is the man who trusts in You. Adonoy, deliver [us]; the King will answer us on the day we call.
sections.he: יְהֹוָה אֱלֺהֵי אַבְרָהָם יִצְחָק וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ שָׁמְרָה זֹאת לְעֹלָם לְיֵֽצֶר מַחְשְׁבוֹת לְבַב עַמֶּֽךָ וְהָכֵן לְבָבָם אֵלֶֽיךָ: וְהוּא רַחוּם יְכַפֵּר עָוֹן וְלֺא יַשְׁחִית וְהִרְבָּה לְהָשִׁיב אַפּוֹ וְלֺא יָעִיר כָּל חֲמָתוֹ: כִּי אַתָּה אֲדֹנָי טוֹב וְסַלָּח וְרַב חֶֽסֶד לְכָל קֹרְאֶֽיךָ: צִדְקָתְךָ צֶֽדֶק לְעוֹלָם וְתוֹרָתְךָ אֱמֶת: תִּתֵּן אֱמֶת לְיַעֲקֹב חֶֽסֶד לְאַבְרָהָם אֲשֶׁר נִשְׁבַּֽעְתָּ לַאֲבוֹתֵֽינוּ מִֽימֵי קֶֽדֶם: בָּרוּךְ אֲדֹנָי יוֹם יוֹם יַעֲמָס לָֽנוּ הָאֵל יְשׁוּעָתֵֽנוּ סֶֽלָה: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת עִמָּֽנוּ מִשְׂגָּב לָֽנוּ אֱלֺהֵי יַעֲקֹב סֶֽלָה: יְהֹוָה צְבָאוֹת אַשְׁרֵי אָדָם בֹּטֵֽחַ בָּךְ: יְהֹוָה הוֹשִֽׁיעָה הַמֶּֽלֶךְ יַעֲנֵֽנוּ בְיוֹם קָרְאֵֽנוּ:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Concluding Prayers, Uva Letzion 9

comments.en:
All who are linked to My name,
Whom I have created,
Formed, and made for My glory—
comments.he: כֹּ֚ל הַנִּקְרָ֣א בִשְׁמִ֔י וְלִכְבוֹדִ֖י בְּרָאתִ֑יו יְצַרְתִּ֖יו אַף־עֲשִׂיתִֽיו׃

comments.en: So when God made me wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘Let this be the kindness that you shall do me: whatever place we come to, say there of me: He is my brother.’”
comments.he: וַיְהִ֞י כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר הִתְע֣וּ אֹתִ֗י אֱלֹהִים֮ מִבֵּ֣ית אָבִי֒ וָאֹמַ֣ר לָ֔הּ זֶ֣ה חַסְדֵּ֔ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשִׂ֖י עִמָּדִ֑י אֶ֤ל כׇּל־הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָב֣וֹא שָׁ֔מָּה אִמְרִי־לִ֖י אָחִ֥י הֽוּא׃

comments.en:
They shall not toil to no purpose;
They shall not bear children for terror,
But they shall be a people blessed by the LORD,
And their offspring shall remain with them.
comments.he: לֹ֤א יִֽיגְעוּ֙ לָרִ֔יק וְלֹ֥א יֵלְד֖וּ לַבֶּהָלָ֑ה כִּ֣י זֶ֜רַע בְּרוּכֵ֤י יְהֹוָה֙ הֵ֔מָּה וְצֶאֱצָאֵיהֶ֖ם אִתָּֽם׃

sections.en: Blessed is He, our God, Who created us for His glory, and set us apart from those who go astray; and gave us the Torah of truth, and eternal life He implanted within us. May He open our heart to His Torah, and instill in our heart love and awe of Him, to do His will and serve Him with a perfect heart, so that we shall not labor in vain nor bring forth that which causes dismay.
sections.he: בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֱלֺהֵֽינוּ שֶׁבְּרָאָֽנוּ לִכְבוֹדוֹ וְהִבְדִּילָֽנוּ מִן הַתּוֹעִים וְנָֽתַן לָֽנוּ תּוֹרַת אֱמֶת וְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם נָטַע בְּתוֹכֵֽנוּ הוּא יִפְתַּח לִבֵּֽנוּ בְּתוֹרָתוֹ וְיָשֵׂם בְּלִבֵּֽנוּ אַהֲבָתוֹ וְיִרְאָתוֹ וְלַעֲשׂוֹת רְצוֹנוֹ וּלְעָבְדוֹ בְּלֵבָב שָׁלֵם לְמַֽעַן לֺא נִיגַע לָרִיק וְלֺא נֵלֵד לַבֶּהָלָה:
sections.ref: Siddur Ashkenaz, Weekday, Shacharit, Concluding Prayers, Uva Letzion 10

comments.en:
that [my] whole being might sing hymns to You endlessly;
O LORD my God, I will praise You forever.
comments.he: לְמַ֤עַן ׀ יְזַמֶּרְךָ֣ כָ֭בוֹד וְלֹ֣א יִדֹּ֑ם יְהֹוָ֥ה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י לְעוֹלָ֥ם אוֹדֶֽךָּ׃ {פ}

comments.en:
Blessed is he who trusts in the LORD,
Whose trust is the LORD alone.
comments.he: בָּר֣וּךְ הַגֶּ֔בֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִבְטַ֖ח בַּיהֹוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֥ה יְהֹוָ֖ה מִבְטַחֽוֹ׃

comments.en:
Trust in the LORD for ever and ever,
For in Yah the LORD you have an everlasting Rock.
comments.he: בִּטְח֥וּ בַֽיהֹוָ֖ה עֲדֵי־עַ֑ד כִּ֚י בְּיָ֣הּ יְהֹוָ֔ה צ֖וּר עוֹלָמִֽים׃

comments.en:
Those who know Your name trust You,
for You do not abandon those who turn to You, O LORD.

comments.en:
The LORD desires His [servant’s] vindication,
That he may magnify and glorify [His] Teaching.
comments.he: יְהֹוָ֥ה חָפֵ֖ץ לְמַ֣עַן צִדְק֑וֹ יַגְדִּ֥יל תּוֹרָ֖ה וְיַאְדִּֽיר׃

sections.en: May it be Your will, Adonoy, our God, and God of our fathers, that we keep Your statutes in this world, and [thus] be privileged to live and behold, and to inherit the goodness and blessing of the Messianic days, and in the life of the World to Come. In order that my soul sing to You and not be stilled; Adonoy, my God, forever will I thank You. Blessed is the man who trusts in Adonoy, so that Adonoy is his security. Trust in Adonoy until the end of days, for in God, Adonoy, is the strength of the worlds. And they will trust in You— those who know your Name, for You have never forsaken those who seek You, Adonoy. Adonoy desired, for the sake of His righteousness, to make the Torah great and to glorify it.
